scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The 'Discovery Files' section for llms.txt switches from the first-person voice ('We find llms.txt present...') used throughout the report's findings sections to a second-person construction ('whether adding it would be worthwhile depends on the actual content depth of the full site') in the immediately following llms-full.txt subsection, breaking the single voice held across all other priority and discovery subsections.
findings.context: Whether adding it would be worthwhile depends on the actual content depth of the full site, which our audited sample of 6 pages does not yet measure

findings.message: Priority 6 states that 'llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agent-card.json, ai.txt, and humans.txt are all absent' as an unqualified site-wide assertion, but the Discovery Files section later reveals that llms.txt is in fact present on the site, making the 'all absent' claim in the Findings table and Priority 6 body inaccurate and inconsistent with evidence recorded elsewhere in the same report.
findings.context: None of the five well-known discovery artefacts are reachable on www.paribu.com: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agent-card.json, ai.txt, and humans.txt are all absent.

findings.message: The At-a-Glance findings table entry for Finding 6 lists 'llms.txt' as absent, but the Discovery Files section records llms.txt as present on the site; these two statements directly contradict each other and mislead the client about the status of their llms.txt file.
findings.context: Discovery Readiness 33/100, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agent-card.json, ai.txt, humans.txt absent

findings.message: The Cross-Host Redirect resilience check is marked 'Fail' on 2 of 6 pages but the data field simultaneously states '0 page(s) redirect to a different host' and '0 page(s) cross origin during redirect', making it impossible to reconcile the Fail verdict with the zero-instance data; the certainty of the Fail status is unsupported by the evidence presented.
findings.context: Cross-Host Redirect | Fail | 2/6 | 0 page(s) redirect to a different host. Agents that enforce same-origin policy may not follow these chains. | 0 page(s) cross origin

findings.message: The Body Content Ratio check reports a passing average of 21% but asserts this is 'well above the 30% threshold', when 21% is in fact below the stated 30% threshold; the confident 'Pass' verdict and the 'well above' qualifier directly contradict the threshold value given in the same row.
findings.context: Body Content Ratio | Pass | 2/2 | Actual prose content averages 21% of served bytes - well above the 30% threshold.
